scope: Reviewed supplemental synthetic changed-label graph screen and focused selector/contract probes. Existing required gate, fleet populations, windows, denominators, and rates are unchanged.

decision.status: not qualified; retain current required gate
decision.goal: At least 30% lower median complete required-feedback time including reruns on representative changed-label graphs, with no worse p90 or flake rate, preserved important behavior/security/platform contracts, and documented resource costs.
decision.reason: The synthetic one-file journal screen is 29.3% lower at the two-run midpoint, but is not a routine PR or complete-gate comparison. Four target substitutions lack semantic-coverage proof; the literal journal-only selector matched 0 of 30 historical changesets; run cache state and focused-pool load differed.
decision.next_evidence: Prioritize an owner-specific graph for common real backend changes, with a contract-to-witness map for important behavior, security, and platform guarantees. Then compare repeated matched end-to-end required-gate runs, including reruns, tails, flake rate, and resource costs. Treat isolated v2 KVM safety and cleanup as secondary evidence; no KVM adoption without ownership and cleanup proof.

synthetic_graph_screen.design: A/B/B/A; baseline A and candidate B; two observations per arm

midpoint_comparison.interpretation: Two-run midpoint for this selected synthetic graph only; not p90, complete PR feedback, or a flake qualification.

test_identity.substitution_status: The four target substitutions do not yet have semantic-coverage proof.

resource_and_confounders.cpu_limit: One baseline action in each run has unknown CPU; the summed ratio is incomplete.
resource_and_confounders.capacity_limit: CU-minutes and peak CU are estimates from action properties, not observed worker capacity or billing.
resource_and_confounders.disk_limit: Disk use is unknown for all 46 actions per arm.
resource_and_confounders.cache_imbalance: A1 had 47 additional build actions; B1, B2, and A2 had none. Full cache accounting is unavailable.
resource_and_confounders.pool_load: A focused render and another worker overlapped B2; shared-pool effect was not measured.

applicability.policy: Current shadow policy uses the literal journal-only path set.
applicability.path_remapping: No old path is remapped to the new journal paths.
applicability.interpretation: The screen does not demonstrate routine changed-label applicability.

corrected_manual_invocation.notes: The earlier 6e38fc22-06bf-4cb5-b6a1-241daf7e76dd attempt selected no TestRunner actions and produced no JUnit cases; it is not a test pass.
corrected_manual_invocation.source_provenance: Source commit 38f6c8e plus the two hashed working-tree patches; not an unmodified commit-only execution.

dispatcher_sharding.identity_union: All three required testcase identities matched, one per independent shard/session.
dispatcher_sharding.interpretation: The candidate does not show a useful complete-action improvement and uses substantially more aggregate CPU/CU-minutes. JUnit time may include fixtures, so it is not treated as pure testcase execution time.

gateway_short_budget.interpretation: The shorter timeout changes the behavior contract, and a single differently configured run is not a matched benefit comparison.

native_cutoff_contract.result: The real cutoff/successor contract passed in 40.7 seconds.
native_cutoff_contract.companion_build: Follow-on explicit build passed changed native fixture libraries and conftest, K3s helpers, and cleanup target at RBE invocation 0e774569; cleanup was not executed. An earlier helper build stopped on Ruff import ordering before it was fixed. Full required checks for a commit containing this overlay are pending.
native_cutoff_contract.limit: Focused overlay evidence only; not full-gate qualification.

same_package_owner_selector.result: All three cases passed with unchanged shadow submissions: journal code plus its test companion is eligible; test-only changes remain ineligible; journal plus proto remains ineligible.
same_package_owner_selector.scope: Direct same-package owner proof only; no historical remapping and no gate change.

prepared_kvm_candidate.exposures: Cold and warm/reuse runs of the same manual candidate target, same runner identity; not routine-required baseline versus candidate.
prepared_kvm_candidate.ownership_blocker: The v1 candidate shares data across containers. Automatic approval review rejected its proposed cleanup because that cleanup mutates the shared CRI store; no cleanup action was submitted or executed, and owner approval remains pending.
prepared_kvm_candidate.next_state: The isolated v2 candidate has not been measured. Baseline shutdown and safe reuse remain unverified. A focused helper/build invocation passed explicit changed-library and baseline/runtime/cleanup-target build checks, but did not execute cleanup; final exact-source CI is pending.
prepared_kvm_candidate.interpretation: Observed cold-to-warm timing only. These runs do not establish safe reuse or justify adoption; ownership and cleanup review is pending.

decision_limits: This is a synthetic one-file journal graph, not a routine PR, whole-three-required-context, p90, or flake qualification.
Three shared Go targets have no testcase identities in JUnit, and four target substitutions lack semantic-coverage proof.
The two baseline CPU totals each omit one action; estimated CU and peak are not observed capacity or billing; disk use is unknown.
A1 cache state differs from the other arms, and B2 shares focused-pool time with unrelated work.
The literal journal-only policy matched 0/30 historical changesets; paths are not remapped.
